reviews.text: This place is amazing.  I love that you can see your companions through the glass.  They have good service packages for our animals. My mother was really impressed with the services.

Customer service was good. They did a great job of communicating and responding. However I was disappointed when I got home and saw his lion mane was cut off and framed to more of a teddy bear face frame when I specifically asked for a lion cut. I really think they should show you your pet before having to pay and leave tip. Overall I was not happy with the cut.  I don’t feel like it’s what I asked for and if there were any questions as to what I wanted I should have been notified. The rest of his body was fine I’m just upset about his face frame and mane being cut off.
Update: so my cat has not been able to regulate his temps due to his mane being cut off. A Siberian should never have their mane removed as it is a triple layer that regulates temps and will never grow back the same. Will not be returning. Staff needs to learn difference between lion and bear cut and basic knowledge.

I want to share the bad experience I had today! I took my two dogs for their grooming appointment—I’ve been taking them there for about three months. I dropped them off at 8:30 in the morning. At 2:30 PM, I called the salon to ask if they were ready, as it was taking unusually long. An hour later, I received a call from a receptionist saying that my female dog was being very aggressive, refusing to let them cut her hair, and that they needed my help. When I arrived at the salon, I told the receptionist I was surprised this was happening, as I had never experienced this before. One of them replied, "Your dog has actually been quite aggressive in the past." I then asked, "Why are you only telling me this now? If that’s true, why wasn't I notified?" She answered, "Well, we always try to work with dogs when they act out or become aggressive, and we try to find a way to complete their grooming." I don't think that was the right answer. If they’ve been working with my dogs all this time knowing she tends to be a bit aggressive, they should have notified me. Also, how could my dog *not* be aggressive? I dropped her off early in the morning, and by 3:30 in the afternoon, they still hadn't groomed her; she was extremely stressed out. I believe the real issue wasn't her stress but the excessive time it took to groom the dogs. Additionally, I tried to help the groomer cut out, but my baby still wouldn't cooperate. She kept whimpering—I’d never seen her so distressed before. I told the groomer to just stop and leave it be—that it wasn't a problem. However, when I left the grooming area, they told me I still had to pay; to make matters worse, they charged me as if they had finished my dog's grooming. I think there’s a serious lack of customer service here. The two young women at the front desk have a lot to learn about dealing with customers. Two other people there voiced the same complaint—that the wait times were too long. I won't speak for anyone else—that’s not my concern—but I am definitely sharing my own experience. I will not be returning for two reasons: first, the poor customer service; and second, the unreasonable length of time it takes to groom the dogs, which explains why they come out so stressed. On top of everything, they even asked me if I could come back in two weeks to get the haircut done! "Seriously?" I asked. "I am not coming back here."

I was honestly so nervous walking into this salon with my girl, Vesper. She was extremely dirty, her skin was irritated, and her coat was uneven and patchy due to allergies. She was shaking like a leaf, and as a pet parent, my heart was breaking.

From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly kind, patient, and welcoming—absolutely no judgment, just compassion and professionalism. They took the time to help calm her down and treated her so gently and confidently that she trusted them enough to go to the back, which says everything.

And the results? Amazing.
She walked in scared and uncomfortable and walked out confident, happy, tail up, and looking absolutely beautiful. Her coat was clean, bright white, and as even as possible considering her skin allergies. You could literally see the difference in her mood—she felt good.

The service was fast, the staff was extremely knowledgeable, the care was impressive, and the price was more than reasonable for the level of attention and love they gave my dog.

I am beyond grateful for how they treated my baby girl. If you have a nervous dog, a dog with skin issues, or just want a groomer who truly cares—this is the place. Highly, highly recommend.
